d1_m1.current_title_en: Experimental Assessment of the Validity and Breakdown of a Continuum Model for Vacuum Layer-Jamming Beams
d1_m1.current_title_vi: Đánh giá thực nghiệm giới hạn hiệu lực và sự mất hiệu lực của mô hình liên tục cho dầm kẹt lớp chân không

reduced_model.title: A continuum-based model for a layer jamming beam

d1_m1.final_research_question: Across a declared range of layer count, vacuum pressure, and quasi-static bending severity, for which measurable outputs and operating conditions does the Zhang et al. continuum layer-jamming beam model meet predeclared, justified error tolerances against a verified full-layer frictional-contact reference and independent experiments, and which contact or slip mechanisms explain failures?
d1_m1.scientific_hypothesis: M1's output-specific error will generally grow as finite-layer discreteness and slip or contact-pressure redistribution become important, yielding experimentally resolvable validity and breakdown regions. The predicted trend and boundary are testable and may be rejected.

mp1.disposition: Not selected in final cross-direction adjudication; retain as viable alternative only.

current_gate.name: D1/M1 boundary-resolvability pilot
current_gate.objective: Demonstrate an uncertainty-resolved accepted/rejected contrast for a shared measurable output within an experimentally accessible domain.
current_gate.first_task: Reconstruct M1 completely and reproduce a published case before freezing the full-layer reference.
pass_requirements: Reconstructed M1 equations, assumptions, and reproduction check
Predeclared primary output, error metric, justified tolerance, and uncertainty budget
At least one accessible accepted condition
At least one accessible rejected condition
Experimental measurement precision sufficient to test the classification

core_rule: DO NOT DEFEND A DIRECTION BY DEFAULT. TEST THE CURRENT FEASIBILITY GATE AND PIVOT IF THE EVIDENCE FAILS.
